The case: defendant impersonated a navy officer, used WeChat to meet victim, claimed single, had sexual relations multiple times. Victim forgave, compensation paid, victim does not pursue criminal or civil liability. What crime? Likely "诈骗" (fraud) or "冒充他人身份诈骗" maybe "冒充军人诈骗罪". In Chinese criminal law, impersonating a military officer to obtain sexual services could be considered "诈骗" (fraud) if there was some financial gain. Here compensation 35000 paid, maybe victim paid money? Not mentioned. The victim didn't pursue criminal liability. The act is sexual exploitation via deception. Could be "强奸" if non-consensual, but victim consent? They had sexual relations, but deception about identity may be considered "诈骗" (fraud) or "冒充军人诈骗罪". Also could be "非法提供性服务" but that's victim's side. The law: Impersonating a military officer is a crime under Article 299 of Criminal Law: "冒充国家机关工作人员进行诈骗的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So "冒充国家机关工作人员诈骗罪". The victim didn't pay money? Compensation was paid by defendant to victim, maybe as restitution. The crime is still fraud. So answer: 诈骗 (冒充军人诈骗). In examples, they sometimes list multiple charges separated by semicolon. Here likely just "诈骗". Could also be "非法侵占"? No. So final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
